common.scope: Provider-free synthetic event and stub-adapter conformance; no provider, model, harness, account, credential, live host or network calls
authorization_prerequisites: A separately authorized local implementation/conformance session
Pinned candidate and independently authored oracle with exact artifact hashes
Disposable synthetic workspace, no actual credentials or external effects
Declared finite bounds and test profile; D028 OS profiles only for separately authorized physical follow-on
Review of current M1A/M1B/M1C interfaces; no silent changes to immutable unions
common.entrypoint_status: No verified runnable room implementation or suite entrypoint exists. Scenario verbs are conceptual inputs, not shell commands.

bound_policy.fairness_assumption: In finite progress cases, independently scheduled control_apply gets one opportunity per virtual tick; no reader progress is assumed. Without this assumption eventual progress is not claimed.
bound_policy.note: Artificial conformance bounds, not production selected limits or measured SLOs. Every bounded dimension has a separate saturation witness.

common.independent_oracle: A separately authored property evaluator consumes immutable initial state, offered inputs, canonical commit/receipt log, projection install/ACK records, effect-recipient stub records and independent tripwire counters. It must not reuse candidate reducers. Compare against explicit permitted transition tables, not graph equality alone.
expected_common_evidence: Candidate/oracle/config/source-manifest SHA-256 and independent verifier identity
Ordered offered-input schedule, virtual time and all fence/lease revisions
Canonical events and refusal receipts, before/after hashes, installation/ACK cursors
Operation ownership and synthetic recipient receipts, reservation ledger
Independent counters for model, worker, actor, index, plugin, credential/network entrypoints
Minimal counterexample and semantic mutant result, including failures
stopping_conditions: Stop the case on any hard invariant violation; preserve the complete first witness before minimizing
Stop on any attempted provider/model/harness/network/credential action; report failed isolation rather than continuing
A missing prerequisite, dead oracle, timeout or uncalibrated numeric SLO is BLOCKED/UNKNOWN, never PASS
Completion requires all declared case permutations and positive controls; do not stop after only negative refusals
common_non_proofs: No live route entitlement or account qualification
No real external rollback, security boundary, production durability or OS containment
No measured human comprehension, accessibility, UI conformance, model quality, quota savings or port cost
Finite schedules are not unbounded proofs; source-documented behavior is not executed behavior
